Crowns, night guards and dentures go to Rowan Ridge Dental Lab, and our contact there is Hal Jensen. Turnaround is 8 business days for crowns and 5 for night guards, so book the seat appointment at least two weeks after the prep. The lab courier picks up at 3:00 on Mondays and Wednesdays, and cases must be bagged and labeled at the front desk by then.
